root_cause.text: The smc_msg_event tracepoint unconditionally dereferences `smc->conn.lnk->ibname` without checking if `smc->conn.lnk` is NULL, which is the case for SMC-D connections (only SMC-R sets `conn->lnk`), leading to a null-pointer dereference when the tracepoint is triggered on an SMC-D socket.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "conn->lnk is only set for SMC-R; for SMC-D it is NULL." and that the crash occurs because the tracepoint uses `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk->ibname)`. The patch changes this to `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk ? smc->conn.lnk->ibname : "")` to handle the NULL case. The faulting address `0x3e0` is confirmed as `offsetof(struct smc_link, ibname)`, proving the NULL dereference.
